name: Asuryani Backgrounds
note: IoE prints no Origin table: Agents choose an Accomplishment and a Goal only, so `origin` is empty. Objectives are on p.12.

accomplishment.name: Denied Destiny
accomplishment.text: Where the Farseers foresaw death, you prevailed, defeating an incredible foe or accomplishing an impossible task.

accomplishment.name: Communed with Infinity
accomplishment.text: You have devoted considerable time to meditation with the spirits of the departed; they have taught you much of life and death.

accomplishment.name: Mon-Keigh Animosity
accomplishment.text: The depraved stupidity of Humanity has endangered your life on more than one occasion. You have survived battles alongside and against them.

accomplishment.name: Webway Explorer
accomplishment.text: Traversing many Webway paths, you have uncovered the hidden and forgotten, recovering valuable artefacts and even more crucial routes.

accomplishment.name: Unusual Ally
accomplishment.text: Your actions saved the life of someone beyond your Faction — a Drukhari, a Harlequin, maybe even an Imperial.

accomplishment.name: Black Library Scholar
accomplishment.text: You have studied the ancient arcane writings of the cryptic Black Library. Obscure knowledge of the profane is your constant companion.

goal.name: Fatalist
goal.text: After a series of unfortunate battles, you have accepted your species is doomed. You seek only protection; a defensible refuge for you and your allies.

goal.name: Renewal
goal.text: Your long life was fraught with the tragic milieu of your Species. You seek new experiences and perspectives to lift your burdens and wash away your sorrows.

goal.name: Serenity
goal.text: Like many of your kind, your emotions are overwhelming to the point of self-destruction. Seek serenity to protect your soul from Slaanesh.

goal.name: Path Mastery
goal.text: You see nothing beyond your current Path and have thrown yourself into it utterly. Whatever your present discipline is, you will be an exemplar and pioneer.

goal.name: Recovery
goal.text: You will restore the lost majesty of your species, finding artefacts and lost knowledge. Are you seeking something specific?

goal.name: Unity
goal.text: The arch-foe cannot be defeated by the dwindling forces of your Species — at least, not fractured as they are. You will forge great alliances and bring unity.

objectives: Unfavourably compare another Species' culture, art, or technology to your own.
Devote an accomplishment or victory to an Aeldari god.
Recount a lesson from the traditions of a craftworld that applies to the current situation.
Utilise the reputation of your Species to manipulate an individual.
Employ knowledge you learned from an earlier Path of your life to the current circumstances.
Apply your superior intellect and sensitivity to prophecy to carry out a perfect plan.

name: Anhrathe Backgrounds
note: Only the Anhrathe Objectives are printed. Corsairs pick Backgrounds and Goals matching their Species (p.14); the "Anhrathe Goal table" p.14 refers to is not printed. `origin`, `accomplishment` and `goal` are empty.
objectives: Raid an enemy voidship.
Berate another Aeldari for the follies of their beliefs.
Perform a great feat to grow your reputation.
Defeat a foe using nothing but threats and your personal infamy.
Employ a value you learned from your former home to overcome an obstacle.
Assert your freedom by breaking a law, cutting a bond, or shirking your responsibilities.

name: Drukhari Backgrounds
note: IoE prints no Origin table: Agents choose an Accomplishment and a Goal only, so `origin` is empty. The Goals are a separate table, DRUKHARI GOALS, on p.16. Also Apocrypha p.60.

accomplishment.name: Arch-Sadist
accomplishment.text: You have committed such appalling atrocities to preserve your own withered soul that even other Drukhari are sickened and impressed.

accomplishment.name: Realspace Terror
accomplishment.text: Your campaigns against dominions of lesser creatures have been especially profitable, reaping a generous bounty of treasures and captives.

accomplishment.name: Master Conspirator
accomplishment.text: You seized your current position through a carefully orchestrated scheme of violence and betrayal.

accomplishment.name: Arena Champion
accomplishment.text: You battled an unusually monstrous foe in the Wych Cult arenas of Commorragh, and survived to tell the tale.

accomplishment.name: Dark Savant
accomplishment.text: You have delved deep into annals of forbidden knowledge, and learned secrets of the ancient Aeldari long forgotten by your short-sighted kin.

accomplishment.name: Conspicuous Mercy
accomplishment.text: You saved the life of a superior, or spared a defeated foe. Some respect your honour, others despise your weakness, and at least one person owes you a favour.

goal.name: Power
goal.text: You must kill your way to the top of the pecking order. Only when all of Commorragh respects your supremacy will you be satisfied.

goal.name: Infamy
goal.text: The whole galaxy will know your name and your exploits — be they terrified prey Species, or infatuated Drukhari admirers.

goal.name: Revenge
goal.text: You were slighted, betrayed, or ejected from power. Now you are determined to avenge yourself upon the culprits, and make them suffer.

goal.name: Self-Gratification
goal.text: All Aeldari become the playthings of thirsting gods in the end. Better to indulge the material pleasures of the flesh in the meantime.

goal.name: Exhilaration
goal.text: You are never more alive than on the precipice of death. You seek the adrenaline rush of high speed and extreme danger.

goal.name: Escape
goal.text: You want out — from Commorragh, from the monotonous cruelty, from the ever-present thirst of Slaanesh. Of course, escaping is far easier said than done…

objectives: Unfavourably compare another Species' culture, art, or technology to your own.
Seize a prize or opportunity that could appease your superior.
Recount how the obsessions of your Kabal, Cult, Coven, or other faction apply to the situation.
Terrify another creature into compliance.
Indulge your appetite for transgressive behaviour.
Apply your superior intellect and devious cunning to carry out a perfect plan.

name: Harlequins Backgrounds
note: IoE prints no Origin table: Agents choose an Accomplishment and a Goal only, so `origin` is empty. Printed "reinact" and "You additions" (Artistic Visionary) are kept as printed. Also Apocrypha p.47.

accomplishment.name: Elevated Understudy
accomplishment.text: You stepped into an important theatrical role with little notice after another Harlequin was too injured to perform. You wonder if you are worthy of the role.

accomplishment.name: Toast of Commorragh
accomplishment.text: Your performance was so well received in the Dark City, they sacrificed a thousand victims in your name. Indeed, the highest of compliments.

accomplishment.name: Hero of the Craftworlds
accomplishment.text: You have joined the Asuryani on extended campaigns, turning the tides of battles in your kin's favour.

accomplishment.name: Crone-Walker
accomplishment.text: You have travelled to the Eye of Terror and recovered priceless relics from the daemon-haunted crone worlds of the ancient Aeldari empire.

accomplishment.name: Artistic Visionary
accomplishment.text: Not content to merely reinact the saedath, you have added your own twists to these bloody performances. You additions garnered a great deal of renown.

accomplishment.name: Divine Visitation
accomplishment.text: You believe you have directly interacted with Cegorach himself, but given the Laughing God's mysterious workings, it's hard to be sure.

goal.name: Mastery
goal.text: You push your body to its limits to fully embody the role you are performing, banishing any trace of your own wants or personality.

goal.name: Mockery
goal.text: You delight at the comeuppance of the prideful, and seek to bring the conceited down a peg or two.

goal.name: Fulfilment
goal.text: You are an agent of destiny, compelled to complete the prophecies of the ancient Aeldari, for good or for ill.

goal.name: Legacy
goal.text: Your chosen role is one that, by rights, should end in glorious death on the battlefield. So far that death has eluded you, but you will find it yet.

goal.name: Education
goal.text: Those who forget the past are doomed to repeat its mistakes. You teach the Aeldari of their heritage so they can rediscover their grace.

goal.name: Defiance
goal.text: There is only one battle that truly matters — the battle against the Ruinous Powers of Chaos. Opposing the Great Enemy is its own reward.

objectives: Unfavourably compare another Species' culture, art, or technology to your own.
Devote an accomplishment or victory to the Laughing God.
Recount a moral from Aeldari mythology that applies to the current situation.
Provoke a strong emotional reaction (e.g. confusion, terror, fury, euphoria) from another creature.
Apply the secret knowledge of the Black Library to the current circumstances.
Perfectly coordinate your movements with your fellow Agents.
